name: Ohime-sama ni Narenakatta Boku wa Kyou mo Gakuran ni Sode o Tousu
original_name: お姫さまになれなかった僕は今日も学ランに袖を通す
source:
Inaba Tomoyo's life was plain and ordinary, until one day, in an empty classroom after school, a girl asked him out for the first time ever. But what happened next was even more surprising. After she left, Mizukoshi Tatsurou, a classmate of Inaba's came in. He seemed to have heard the two talking. Inaba thought he would make fun of the whole thing, but Mizukoshi seemed angry...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ296393.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
稻叶知世一直过着平淡无奇的生活。直到某天放学后，在一间空教室里，他第一次收到了女孩子的告白。然而，接下来发生的事更加出乎意料。女孩离开后，稻叶的同班同学水越龙郎走了进来，似乎听见了刚才的对话。稻叶以为他会拿这件事取笑自己，可水越看起来却很生气……

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ296393.html]DLsite[/url]]
